claims.statement: The agent derives resumed model history from its JSONL log, skips crash-truncated lines, and records compaction without deleting older messages or splitting call-result pairs.
Entirely read-only permitted tool batches run concurrently, while other batches execute in order and distinguish interrupted calls from calls not run.
RPC plan gating rejects file mutations and mutating MCP calls; outside-sandbox bash asks every time while sandboxing is on, regardless of the normal approval mode.
Sandboxing defaults on, is configured by CLI then environment and user sandbox.json, and refuses commands if the machine cannot sandbox; file tools follow the same access view.
File edits and overwrites are refused after an observed file changes until reread, using recorded size, modification time and hash.
In-process task subagents have restricted tools, cannot recursively delegate or use desktop tools, share approval and cancellation, and run at most four at a time.
Sandbox tests cover hidden secrets through symlinks and parent traversal and prevent broad working directories from making the whole home writable.
Provider settings support Responses and chat-completions endpoints and are reread for each request.
Usage accounting separates cached input and cost classification; budgets count uncached input, output and estimates of missing usage, while mixed priced/unknown requests yield partly known cost.
Provider configuration supports per-million-token prices and thinking-level mappings, while built-in Responses web search is limited to plan/OpenAI routes and can be disabled by environment.
Unpriced providers require explicit free=true for local/no-extra-cost classification regardless of address; configured or listed model pricing takes precedence over that flag.

Missing either input or output token usage increments unreported counts and makes priced requests unknown-cost; logs, aggregate details and subagent totals preserve uncertainty and separate budget-only estimates.
Responses cut off by the server carry their usage into an error which the main agent charges and logs before propagating the failure.

Shared budget admission atomically reserves estimated request tokens, with 2000 tokens of reply room, across main, side, compaction and web-search requests; admission stops at spent-plus-held limits but admitted requests can overshoot.
Fallback records and announces the model change then restarts the run-loop request path rather than resending an already prepared request for the old model.
Completed side-question usage is attributed to its originating session log even after switching sessions, and RPC shutdown waits at most ten seconds for outstanding side tasks before settling usage.
MCP servers start concurrently with a default ten-second startup timeout; after two seconds the agent reports still-pending servers and their timeout allowance.

File reads deliver nested rules once while present in history, while edits encountering unseen rules stop before changing anything and return those rules for reconsideration; hidden/dependency folders are skipped, rules are capped at 8 KB, and delivery state is rebuilt after history changes.
Large-file reads retain a bounded line selection and whole-file hash, while grep incrementally processes output with bounded preview and spill behavior rather than collecting all matches in memory.
Foreground shell execution drains stdout and stderr independently and cleans up its process group on cancellation, timeout, dropped futures, and command completion.
Provider refusal text is bounded to 64 KiB within the response timeout, and completed SSE events are checked against the event-size limit before delivery.
Explore-only sandbox views explicitly mount the project and shared Git directory read-only even under writable ancestors; this shell-level guarantee requires sandboxing.
Isolated subagent tree capture excludes Python bytecode and common Python tool caches, preventing cache changes from blocking real edits during merge-back.
Web searches settle token spend before releasing their budget holds, and parent tool-result aggregation adds usage without charging that spend twice.
Stop interrupts desktop-tool discovery and MCP startup; an incomplete MCP start is retried on a subsequent prompt.

MCP schemas exceeding a configurable 12000-byte threshold are replaced by tool search and indirect calls, with up to eight search matches; indirect calls resolve before read-only, approval and plan checks.
Overlong read lines report truncation and continuation guidance; file-name search streams paths while retaining only a bounded alphabetically first set and the total count.
